project_type: Static blog, migrating from Jekyll (Minimal Mistakes remote theme) to Astro 7 (TypeScript, content collections), deployed to GitHub Pages at custom domain mohashi.io
language: Markdown content + Astro/TypeScript (target); Liquid/Kramdown + Ruby/Jekyll (source, being removed)
build_system: npm (Astro's own CLI/Vite build, no Brazil package in this worktree). Node v10.24.1 is the current environment default and is INCOMPATIBLE with Astro 7 (requires ^18.20.8 || ^20.3.0 || >=22.0.0) - the coder must switch to a supported Node version (nvm or equivalent) before scaffolding or building.
test_framework: none (no test suite exists or is planned; verification is via `npm run build` succeeding and inspecting generated dist/ output with grep/file checks, per design.md's explicit verification requirements)
build_command: npm install && npm run build (run from the worktree root after scaffolding)
test_command: none; use `npm run build` as the verification gate, plus grep/file-existence checks against dist/ output as specified in each FEAT's verification steps
verification_instructions: After each FEAT's steps: run `npm run build` from the worktree root and confirm exit code 0. Then run the specific grep/file-existence checks listed in that FEAT's verification array against the dist/ directory. The final full verification (FEAT-002's last step) does a clean `rm -rf dist .astro node_modules && npm install && npm run build` and checks for: both post pages, a listing page, sitemap.xml/sitemap-index.xml, rss.xml, OG meta tags in post HTML, and dist/CNAME.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/, .astro/, and node_modules/ are all build output/generated and must be gitignored (see FEAT-001 step on .gitignore), never committed.
environment_constraints: Node v10.24.1 is the ambient default and cannot run Astro 7 - a supported Node version must be activated (e.g. via nvm) before any npm create/install/build command in this task. Do NOT push to git or trigger the GitHub Actions deploy workflow - the task explicitly forbids triggering deployment. Work ONLY inside the worktree /Users/mgohashi/Repos/github.com/mgohashi/mgohashi.github.io/.worktrees/astro-migration; never touch the main checkout at /Users/mgohashi/Repos/github.com/mgohashi/mgohashi.github.io (sibling directory, NOT a subdirectory) except in a later, separate merge step outside this task's scope.
contribution_requirements: Commit locally on the existing branch `migrate-astro` as work progresses (do not create a new branch, do not push). No CONTRIBUTING.md/AGENTS.md exists in this repo. Follow Amazon's git commit message conventions (Conventional Commits) for any commits made during this task.
key_patterns: The approved design (.agents/tasks/design.md, APPROVED revision 3, 0 HIGH/0 MEDIUM/1 NIT per design-review.md) is the authoritative source for every decision: scaffold Astro 7 TypeScript-strict from the official `blog` template via `npm create astro@latest`; content collection schema in section 2 (title, description, pubDate, updatedDate, heroImage via image(), tags, categories, author default 'Marcelo Ohashi', draft default false); frontmatter mapping table and concrete frontmatter blocks for both real posts in section 2; explicit drop decisions for drafts (3.1), analytics (3.2), and Disqus comments (3.3); SEO/OG/Twitter/canonical/sitemap/RSS mechanics in section 4 (note the design review's one NIT: prefer `heroImage.src` directly over `getImage()`, matching the official template's own BaseHead.astro pattern); image optimization via astro:assets with GIFs left unoptimized as plain in section 5; accessibility requirements (skip link, landmarks, heading hierarchy, alt text, contrast, keyboard nav) in section 6; the deploy.yml content in section 7 (withastro/action, do not trigger); and the ordered Jekyll cleanup plan (extract fully before deleting anything) in section 8.
